market_rationale: Cross-sectional outcomes are widely dispersed, although the aggregate dispersion statistic is missing and Ethereum is an extreme outlier. Strong spending and expansionary ISM readings coexist with weak payroll growth, elevated inflation and a tightening Fed. This supports selective earnings-linked reversals and energy exposure rather than indiscriminate dip buying. Recent-return and active-return columns cover different windows; neither is treated as a forecast. Quality scores measure price behavior, not verified balance-sheet quality.
portfolio_rationale: Energy has the strongest independent macro support but is supported continuation, not an overreaction. Financials offer the clearest eligible relative-reversal thesis, with imminent earnings and resilient activity supporting a modest edge. Korea receives a fair reversal assessment but remains below the eligibility threshold because its price-based quality score is offset by extreme risk and missing fundamental confirmation. Unfilled slots appropriately remain in SPY rather than forcing additional reversal labels.
